title: Mutation Testing Report
description: Machine-readable mutation testing report emitted by scripts/mutation_policy.py after classifying mutmut 3.x result output. The wrapper runs `mutmut results --all`, parses the text output, classifies each mutant, and emits this report before returning a classified exit code.

tool.description: Name of the mutation testing tool whose results were classified.

version.description: Detected mutmut version string, or 'unknown' when the tool could not be invoked.

total_mutants.description: Total number of mutants observed in the mutmut results output.

killed.description: Mutants detected by the test suite (good outcome).

survived.description: Mutants not detected by the test suite (actionable).

timeout.description: Mutants whose test run timed out (actionable).

status.description: Aggregate policy status. 'clean' = no actionable mutants; 'findings' = at least one survived/timeout/suspicious mutant; 'tool-error' = mutmut was unavailable or its output was unparseable.

survivors.description: Actionable mutant entries (categories survived, timeout, suspicious). Empty unless status is 'findings'.

key.description: Fully-qualified mutant key reported by mutmut.

category.description: The normalised policy category for this actionable mutant.

error.description: Diagnostic message populated only when status is 'tool-error'.
